A '''hypoinjector wristband''' was a nondescript wristband that was designed to protect the wearer against [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] and other environmental toxins.

It had room for eight doses of vaccines, antitoxins, or other medication. An onboard [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] would constantly scan the wearer and if it detected the presence of something deadly, it would automatically inject the appropriate chemical to counteract it. It operated on two [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] that allowed five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of constant use.
